result.topic_en: Bare algebraic calculations on cross-ratio-like relations between quadratic/bilinear equations, ending in an identity among the roots of a pencil of quadratics. An unrelated, upside-down letter opening dated Göttingen, 6 Aug 1857 appears at the bottom.

methods.what: Equality of cross-ratios relating x,z and y,η
Symmetric biquadratic relation between x and y and its expanded form, with discriminant condition
Linear dependence of three quadratics (pencil) and the determination of m, n by substituting roots
